title: To permit the Scipio A. Jones Post Office in Little Rock, Arkansas, to accept and display a portrait of Scipio A. Jones, and for other purposes.
official_summary: This bill permits the postmaster of the Scipio A. Jones Post Office in Little Rock, Arkansas, to accept and display in the lobby of such post office a portrait, painted by artist Wade Hampton, of Scipio A. Jones.

summary.headline: A new law lets the Little Rock, Arkansas post office named after Scipio A. Jones display a portrait of him in its lobby.
summary.what_it_does: The law allows the postmaster of the Scipio A. Jones Post Office in Little Rock, Arkansas, to accept a portrait of Scipio A. Jones painted by artist Wade Hampton. The postmaster may display it in the post office lobby. It is a permission measure about a single building and does not create new rules for the public.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: It took effect when it was signed into law on December 3, 2020.
